name: Active buzzer TMB12A03, 3 V, 12 mm
description: Active magnetic buzzer: it has its own oscillator, so plain DC on its legs gives a steady tone of about 2.3 to 2.4 kHz (no PWM needed). Rated 3 V. The + leg is marked on the body and the seal sticker. The seal keeps flux out during washing: peel it off after soldering, or the buzzer stays quiet.
maker: TMB12A03 (made by Huaneng and by YUEXIN, among others; the maker of this one is not marked)

identified.how: from the kit photo (BZ1 next to the ESP32: the TMB12A marking, the + mark, the washing seal) and the owner, who read the full marking TMB12A03 on 2026-11-19

footprint.name: BUZZER_TMB12A03
footprint.why: pitch 7.6 mm from the sellers' listings and the common footprint BUZ-TH_BD12.0-P7.60; the owner measured about 8 mm with a ruler, which agrees within a ruler's reading. Drill 1.0 mm for legs of about 0.6 mm. The circle is the 12 mm body

electrical.rated_voltage: 3 V DC (operating range 1.5 to 4 or 5 V depending on the listing)
electrical.on_an_esp32: 30 mA is more than an ESP32 GPIO should supply (about 20 mA is the safe figure): drive it through an NPN transistor or a small MOSFET from the 3V3 rail, with a resistor into the base or gate

pins: negative: to the transistor's collector or drain, which switches it to GND
